title: TokenRequest
description: The parameters /oauth/token accepts, derived from identity_oidc::request::TokenRequest. These are form-encoded parameters, not a JSON body — the type is a plain struct with serde derives, so a JSON document is used here only to make the field names and requiredness checkable. grant_type is a String rather than an enum tag on purpose: an unsupported grant must be answered with an OAuth error response, not a deserialization failure, so a client sending grant_type=password gets 501 and unsupported_grant_type rather than a 400 from a parser.
x-serde-status: the type is IMPLEMENTED as a shape; the endpoint that would redeem it is DEFERRED to phase 4 (OIDC provider)

grant_type.description: The discriminator the endpoint switches on. Recognised: authorization_code and refresh_token. Anything else — including the implicit and password grants — is GrantType::Unsupported and is refused with the OAuth error shape, not a parse error.

x-accepted-values.constraining: the field is a String in Rust; the set is closed by grant(), which maps any other value to Unsupported

code.description: The authorization code, for the authorization_code grant. Single-use: a second redemption is refused.
code.x-serde-note: Option<String> with no skip_serializing_if and no default attribute.

redirect_uri.description: The redirect URI, which must equal the one in the authorization request. Re-sending it is not redundancy: it is the check that a code stolen from a log cannot be redeemed by a different client.
redirect_uri.x-serde-note: Option<String> with no skip_serializing_if and no default attribute.

client_id.description: The client identifier, when the client is not authenticating with HTTP basic auth.
client_id.x-serde-note: Option<String> with no skip_serializing_if and no default attribute.

client_secret.description: The client secret, when the client is using client_secret_post. Not accepted for public clients. A credential: it never appears in a log, a response body or any read of the registration.
client_secret.x-serde-note: Option<String> with no skip_serializing_if and no default attribute.

refresh_token.description: The refresh token, for the refresh_token grant.
refresh_token.x-serde-note: Option<String> with no skip_serializing_if and no default attribute.

code_verifier.description: The PKCE verifier, for the authorization_code grant. Checked against the code_challenge the authorization request carried.
code_verifier.x-serde-note: Option<String> with no skip_serializing_if and no default attribute.

scope.description: Requested scopes on a refresh. A refresh may narrow a grant and never widen one. Space-delimited; an absent value parses to the empty list, which narrows to nothing rather than failing.
scope.x-serde-note: Option<String> with no skip_serializing_if and no default attribute. TokenRequest::scopes treats None as an empty list.
